{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2015}}
{{main article|2015 World Table Tennis Championships}}

[[Zhang Jike]] was the defending champion but lost in the semifinals.<ref>[http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_wttc_web2.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=2503&Singles=1 Entry list]</ref>

[[Ma Long (table tennis)|Ma Long]] defeated [[Fang Bo]] 11–7, 7–11, 11–4, 11–8, 11–13, 11–4 in the final to win the title.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=39542&Competition_ID=2503&|title=Ma Long, World Number One, Now Champion of the World|date=3 May 2015|work=ittf.com}}</ref>

==Seeds==
Matches were best of 7 games in qualification and in the 128-player sized main draw.<ref>[http://www.ittf.com//World_Events/wttc_2015/Playing%20system_WTTC2015.pdf Playing system]</ref><ref>[http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_wttc_web2.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=2503&Singles=1&Seeded_Singles=1 Seeds]</ref>
